build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build:cli && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://127.0.0.1:5173; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
